description: Record the whole CLI app's behavior: run the original on its own documented examples, an inputs file and semantic traps (non-ASCII and emoji, negative division, overflow, float extremes, map order), twice each. What differs between runs is reported by kind in `noise`: values (now [..] wildcards), order (lines compared in any order) and lines (a ... that matches anything): show every one to the user. Cases are trycmd files in <repo>/rust/app-cases/ (argv, stdin, env, files in; stdout, stderr, exit code, files out).

args.description: Servers: arguments every start gets after its command, the original's and every build's (["db.json"]). Implies http; saved.

db_dump.description: Shell command that prints the database's state (e.g. `sqlite3 app.db .dump`), run after each case or request and recorded with the effects.

db_reset.description: Shell command that resets the database before each case (each start for servers); cases then run one at a time.

effect_env.description: Point the app's own settings at a sink: VAR=http-url, VAR=smtp-host, VAR=smtp-port or VAR=smtp-url.

effects.description: Record what leaves the process: "http" (a local sink set as HTTP_PROXY, http_proxy and RUST_ANYTHING_HTTP_SINK) and "smtp" (a local mail server, SMTP_HOST and SMTP_PORT). Each case stores what reached them, in order, and replay compares it.

float_file.description: Written files of raw floats, compared value by value within float_tolerance: `PATH=f32le` or `PATH=f64le`. Saved with the cases.

float_tolerance.description: Numeric output: numbers match when they differ by at most this times the larger magnitude (absolute below 1), e.g. 1e-9. Saved with the cases; 0 removes it.

fresh.description: Repository files or folders the app reads or writes (a project tree, a database file), snapshotted and copied into a fresh working directory before every case (CLIs) or start (servers); a CLI's removed files are compared too. Saved.

http.description: The app is a server: `run` starts it (it takes its port from PORT or {port}); cases are requests from curl lines in its docs, `inputs` ({"name", "method", "path", "headers", "body"}) and traps.

name.description: Name the app is invoked by in its docs.

normalize.description: Normalizers: timestamps, uuids, key-order, or name=regex.

pace.description: Servers: milliseconds to wait after each response, for work the server does after answering (a file watcher). Implies http; saved and used by replay; 0 removes it.

port.description: A port the server always listens on (implies http).

run.description: Command that runs the original, paths relative to repo: ["python3", "cli.py"]. Optional after the first record.

timeout.description: Seconds before a run is killed (default 30).

name: app_record
title: Record whole app
